fields.name: entries
fields.description: Relative path of the file to delete. Supports single-segment * wildcards. A mods/ entry may contain an optional SHA-256 hash used only when its file name does not match.

categories.description: Delete path with optional hash fallback for files under mods/. File names are matched first.

fields.name: hash
fields.description: SHA-256 fallback when the mods/ file name is not found. The parent directory still matches by path.

fields.name: entries
fields.description:
Add-file rule. Override mode:
Checked: overwrite (true), replace every file inside the folder.
Unchecked: do not overwrite (false), skip files with the same name inside the folder.
all: replace the entire folder, adjust manually in raw mode.
none: skip when a folder with the same name already exists, adjust manually in raw mode.
